comment: USCRN sub-hourly validation stations for the thermometer-shop synthetic weather. Chosen near sea level (the lab's synthetic baseline has no altitude), on two coasts for two cloud regimes: Pacific marine stratiform vs Atlantic convective cumulus. slug matches the USCRN subhourly01 filename; tzMeridian is the station's standard-time meridian (LST in the files is standard time year-round).
